title: Foundations of Screens and Devices: Protecting the Young Child from Birth
description: A parenting pathway on screens and devices from birth to age three: quality content, parent participation, play and direct interaction as alternatives, and protecting sleep and development. AAP’s statement of 20 January 2026 focuses on family needs, content quality and healthy activities; suggested limits might be under one hour daily for toddlers and preschoolers. WHO 2019 is presented separately: sedentary screen time is not recommended before age two; at age two, no more than one hour daily, less is better. These are distinct recommendations, not one shared rule.
